notes.accuracy_over_all: correct / n (all questions, unscored count as not correct); the task-defined accuracy. 'accuracy' is correct / scored.
notes.precision_excl_abstain: precision and recall means over scored rows that are not abstain-expected (abstain-expected rows score P=R=1 when refused, which lifts the plain means).
notes.accuracy: correct is value/term based. wrong_page rows count as correct for accuracy.
notes.wrong_page: value correct but the cited page is not in gold pages. Reported in failure_category only; not an accuracy miss.
notes.page_strict_rate: strict page check: cited page must be a gold page or in acceptable_pages (other pages of the same filing that carry the value, D-081). Not used for accuracy.
notes.doc_hit_rate: cited doc is a gold doc (answered rows only).
notes.unscored: rows with no checkable gold (no number, no term) have no correct, precision, recall or citation score and are excluded from all means. They stay listed in per_question.csv with failure_category unscored.
